items.name: Open intake
items.description: people can raise concerns through assisted, offline, telephone, postal and accessible digital channels. No mandatory Aadhaar, smartphone or English proficiency.

items.name: Named responsibility
items.description: every case has a verified lead office, relevant co-owners, applicable rules and an accountable response date.

items.name: Reasoned response
items.description: explain evidence, jurisdiction, proposed action or refusal, and how to challenge the decision.

items.name: Affected-person deliberation
items.description: serious systemic issues receive a fair hearing, including counterarguments and preserved dissent.

items.name: Evidence of change
items.description: distinguish action promised, action completed and outcome independently verified.

items.name: Protection
items.description: collect only necessary personal information; obtain consent for attribution; protect people from exposure and retaliation.

items.name: Rights before popularity
items.description: low-volume harms are not discarded because they lack signatures, followers or media attention.

caveat: These are proposed commitments requiring adoption. They are not existing universal legal guarantees. Electoral participation, RTI eligibility, statutory appeals and institutional mandates retain their own rules.
